# Sebastian Kolbusz — Creative Developer · Full-stack Engineer

> Personal site of Sebastian Kolbusz, a creative developer and full-stack engineer based in Zakopane, Poland: animated websites (GSAP, WebGL), Next.js applications and Payload CMS. Founder of stronypodhale.pl, a web studio for small businesses in Podhale.

## About

Sebastian Kolbusz builds animated websites and web applications with React, Next.js, TypeScript, GSAP and WebGL, and content-managed sites on Payload CMS, for companies and agencies in Poland and abroad.

Websites for small businesses in Podhale (Zakopane, Nowy Targ and the surrounding area) are made and maintained by his studio, stronypodhale.pl — offer, prices and client work are described there: https://stronypodhale.pl/

Location: Zakopane, Poland
Email: office@kolbusz.xyz

## Services

- **Animated websites** — Landing pages and multi-page sites with motion, WebGL and custom interactions
- **Web applications** — SaaS and data-driven React/Next.js applications
- **Payload CMS** — Content-managed sites and admin panels
- **Hourly consulting** — Frontend architecture, performance audits, and code reviews

## Skills & Technologies

Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, WebGL / Three.js, Lenis (smooth scroll), Payload CMS, Zustand, Vitest, Playwright, Vercel, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL (basic), Figma

## Work

- **ready2order** — Senior Frontend Engineer role on an enterprise POS SaaS product (2019–2025)
- **stronypodhale.pl** — Founder of a web studio for small businesses in Podhale; its client work (Zakofy, Your Krakow Travel, Wellezza, KAF Garage and others) is described at https://stronypodhale.pl/#realizacje
